## <span class="en">Study design</span><span class="zh">研究设计</span>

::: {.en}
**Destinations** are physical stations. Interchange codes and renumbered codes are
collapsed, which gives `r nrow(dE)` open stations, `r sum(dE$lrt)` of them LRT only. **Origins**
are 500 m hexagons (flat-to-flat) holding residents, workplaces or dormitories,
`r n_fmt(nrow(origins))` in all. Each is represented by its population-weighted centre, which
removes most of the error of treating a cell as a point. **Distance** is straight-line, in
kilometres; walking networks and feeder bus routes are not modelled (see @sec-limits).

**Ridership** is the average daily tap-in, over August and September 2026, with weekdays
and weekends weighted as in a normal week: `r n_fmt(AR$daily_total)` tap-ins a day. Tap-ins count entries
through a gate, so a transfer inside the paid area is not ridership at the station where it
happens. This is the quantity the brief asks for, and also the main limitation of a
station-level model, to which @sec-va returns. Two reference points give this figure scale:
`r n_fmt(AR$wd_total)` tap-ins on an average weekday and `r n_fmt(AR$we_total)` on a weekend or holiday.

**The proposed network** is the brief's: all Jurong Region Line stations opening by 2029
and Cross Island Line Phase 1. That is `r AF$n_new + AF$n_gains` station codes. They are not `r AF$n_new + AF$n_gains` new
places. Seven are new codes at stations that already exist: Choa Chu Kang, Boon Lay,
Jurong East, Pasir Ris, Hougang, Ang Mo Kio and Bright Hill. A passenger reaches them through
the same gates as today, so they are treated as existing stations gaining a line. The
other `r AF$n_new` are new access points. @fig-network shows both.
:::

::: {.zh}
**目的地**是实体车站。换乘站代码与更改过的代码都被合并，得到 `r nrow(dE)` 个开放车站，其中 `r sum(dE$lrt)` 个
只有轻轨。**起点**是 500 米的六边形（对边距离），其中有居民、工作场所或宿舍，共
`r n_fmt(nrow(origins))` 个；每个六边形以人口加权中心代表，这消除了把单元当作一个点所带来的大部分误差。
**距离**为直线距离，单位公里；步行网络与接驳公交线路未纳入模型（见 @sec-limits）。

**客流**是 2026 年 8、9 月的平均每日进站量，按正常一周的结构为工作日与周末加权：每日
`r n_fmt(AR$daily_total)` 次。进站量统计的是通过闸机的次数，因此付费区内的换乘不算发生换乘的车站的客流。
这是题目要求的量，也是车站层面模型的主要局限，@sec-va 将再次讨论。两个参照点可以说明这个数字的规模：
平均工作日 `r n_fmt(AR$wd_total)` 次，周末或假日 `r n_fmt(AR$we_total)` 次。

**拟建网络**按题目要求，包括 2029 年前开通的裕廊区域线全部车站与跨岛线第一期，共 `r AF$n_new + AF$n_gains` 个
车站代码。但它们并不是 `r AF$n_new + AF$n_gains` 个新地点。其中 7 个是现有车站的新代码：Choa Chu Kang、Boon Lay、
Jurong East、Pasir Ris、Hougang、Ang Mo Kio 与 Bright Hill。乘客仍通过今天的闸机进站，因此它们被视为
增加一条线路的现有车站；其余 `r AF$n_new` 个才是新的进站点。@fig-network 显示了这两类车站。
:::

```{r}
#| label: fig-network
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>The rail network in September 2026 and the proposed stations. Colours are the official line colours of the two new lines.</span><span class='zh'>2026 年 9 月的铁路网与拟建车站。颜色为两条新线的官方线路色。</span>"
#| fig-height: 6.2
#| code-fold: true

new_pts <- dP |> filter(role == "new access point")
gain_pts <- dP |> filter(role == "existing, gains a line")
map_base(
  net_layer(), new_layer(0.9),
  geom_point(data = filter(dP, status == "open"), aes(x, y), size = 0.55, colour = "#78716c"),
  geom_point(data = new_pts, aes(x, y, fill = "New access point"), shape = 21, size = 2.1, colour = "white", stroke = .25),
  geom_point(data = gain_pts, aes(x, y, fill = "Existing station, gains a line"), shape = 23, size = 3, colour = "white", stroke = .3),
  geom_text_repel(data = gain_pts, aes(x, y, label = station_name), size = 2.7, min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.size = .2, box.padding = .5, seed = 1)
) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = PAL_LINE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("New access point" = PAL$new, "Existing station, gains a line" = "#1d4ed8"), name = NULL) +
  labs(title = paste(AF$n_new, "new access points, and seven existing stations that gain a line"),
       subtitle = "Grey: the network open in September 2026. Teal: Jurong Region Line. Green: Cross Island Line Phase 1.") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

::: {.interp .en}
**Most of the new stations fill gaps rather than extend the network.** The Jurong Region Line
weaves through the west, where most residents are already within reach of the East-West or
North-South lines, and the Cross Island Line runs across the north-east through towns already
served by the North East and Circle lines. The share of residents within 800 m of a station rises only
from `r pct(100 * SC$cov_old["within_0.8"])` to `r pct(100 * SC$cov_new["within_0.8"])`, and `r pct(100 * AF$res_by_nearest[1] + 100 * AF$res_by_nearest[2] + 100 * AF$res_by_nearest[3] + 100 * AF$res_by_nearest[4], 1)`
already live within 2 km. That makes competition with existing stations, not fresh territory,
the central modelling problem.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**大多数新站是在填补空隙，而不是向外延伸。** 裕廊区域线在西部穿行，那里的多数居民本来就能到达东西线或南北线；
跨岛线则横穿东北部，途经已有东北线与环线服务的市镇。居住在车站 800 米范围内的居民比例只从
`r pct(100 * SC$cov_old["within_0.8"])` 升到 `r pct(100 * SC$cov_new["within_0.8"])`，而
`r pct(100 * AF$res_by_nearest[1] + 100 * AF$res_by_nearest[2] + 100 * AF$res_by_nearest[3] + 100 * AF$res_by_nearest[4], 1)`
的居民已经住在车站 2 公里之内。因此建模的核心问题是与既有车站的竞争，而不是开拓新的地域。
:::
